facts.text: Families watch reports of troops gathering in the Persian Gulf after an invasion of a neighboring country.
Television viewers follow news of a short ground campaign in the Persian Gulf.
Residents hear national reports about a major federal law protecting people with disabilities.
Census workers count households across the country for the new decade.
Newspapers report that the large eastern European federation has dissolved into independent countries.
Families watch reports of a major volcanic eruption in the Philippines disrupting air travel.
Residents hear about a powerful hurricane striking southern Florida and damaging many homes.
A presidential election fills the autumn news with debates and campaign coverage.
Residents hear reports of unrest in a large western city after a controversial court verdict.
Television news follows severe flooding along the Mississippi River and nearby communities.
Residents hear that a new federal family leave law protects eligible workers taking unpaid leave.
Newspapers describe a bombing at a major office complex in a northeastern city.
Families watch coverage of a major earthquake damaging roads and buildings in southern California.
Residents follow reports of an international agreement reducing trade barriers across North America.
A national election changes which party controls both chambers of the national legislature.
News broadcasts report a deadly bombing at a federal building in the central United States.
Many residents hear about a long federal government shutdown affecting public services.
Television reports describe a new space shuttle mission linking with an orbiting space station.
Summer sports coverage focuses on an international athletic competition hosted in the southeastern United States.
A presidential election keeps national campaign coverage on television through the autumn.
Residents hear that a new federal welfare law changes rules for cash assistance.
Families watch reports of a robotic vehicle exploring the surface of Mars.
Newspapers report major flooding along the Red River in the northern plains.
Residents follow news of a presidential impeachment vote in the national legislature.
Families watch coverage of the first pieces of a new international space station entering orbit.
Local officials remind residents to prepare for possible computer problems when the calendar changes to the year 2000.
